questions.question: The SI unit of the rate of flow of heat is: (a) joule (b) watt (c) calorie (d) calorie per square metre
questions.solution:
**Correct option: (b) watt.**

The rate of flow of heat is the quantity of heat $Q$ transferred per unit time $t$:
$$\text{Rate of heat flow} = \frac{Q}{t}$$
Since heat is measured in joules and time in seconds, the unit is
$$\frac{\text{joule}}{\text{second}} = \text{J s}^{-1} = \mathbf{watt\ (W)}$$
Note that option (d) 'calorie per square metre' relates to heat **density**, not the rate of flow.
questions.knowledgeNote: Rate of heat flow has SI unit joule per second, which is the watt.
